notes: Added NEW and APP patient tags, toggled from the edit-problem screen
Hold the timer button to reset it; New Day now also resets all timers automatically
Editing a to-do/reminder now lets you change its priority, not just the text
Fixed the Consult auto-cascade: typing Consult now immediately shows Consult called? and Recs followed? checkboxes
Fixed a scroll-jump bug that occurred after adding or editing a to-do/reminder
Discharge Pending is now a running list of multiple items instead of a single reason
Opening a card now automatically collapses any other open card, on both Rounds and Dispo tabs
M.O.I.S.T. discharge checklist checkboxes now align consistently regardless of label length, with a cleaner bold-first-letter style
Reminders tab priority chips are now clickable filters
Added a Dispo jump button on each Rounds card to open that patient's Dispo entry directly
